tasks.label: Pre-Review Checks
tasks.command: echo '🔍 Running pre-review checks...' && echo '' && echo '📦 Build...' && echo '   (uncomment build command for your stack)' && echo '' && echo '🧹 Lint...' && echo '   (uncomment lint command for your stack)' && echo '' && echo '🧪 Tests...' && echo '   (uncomment test command for your stack)' && echo '' && echo '✅ Pre-review checks complete.'
tasks.detail: Run build, lint, and test checks before requesting a review. Customize the commands for your stack.

tasks.label: Architect: New Design Doc
args: $name = '${input:featureName}'; $dir = 'docs/design'; if (!(Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }; $content = "# $name Design`n`n## Problem Statement`nWhat are we solving and why?`n`n## Constraints`nHard requirements, performance targets, compatibility needs.`n`n## Approach`nHow will we solve it?`n`n## Data Model`nTypes, schemas, interfaces.`n`n## API Surface`nEndpoints, function signatures, events.`n`n## Infrastructure`nAzure resources, Terraform modules, networking.`n`n## Security`nRBAC, secrets management, network boundaries.`n`n## Trade-offs`nWhat did we consider and reject? Why?`n`n## Open Questions`nWhat still needs input?"; Set-Content -Path "$dir/$name.md" -Value $content -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Created $dir/$name.md"
tasks.detail: Create a new design document from the Architect template.

tasks.label: Architect: New ADR
args: $num = '${input:adrNumber}'; $slug = '${input:adrSlug}'; $title = '${input:adrTitle}'; $dir = 'docs/adr'; if (!(Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force }; $content = "# ADR-$num`: $title`n`n## Status: Proposed`n`n## Context`nWhat forces are at play?`n`n## Decision`nWhat are we doing?`n`n## Consequences`nWhat becomes easier? What becomes harder?"; Set-Content -Path "$dir/$num-$slug.md" -Value $content -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Created $dir/$num-$slug.md"
tasks.detail: Create a new Architecture Decision Record.

tasks.label: Terraform: Validate
args: Write-Host '🔍 Terraform format check...' ; terraform fmt -check -recursive ; Write-Host '✅ Validating...' ; terraform validate ; Write-Host '📋 Planning...' ; terraform plan -no-color
tasks.detail: Run terraform fmt check, validate, and plan.

tasks.label: Ansible: Lint
tasks.detail: Run ansible-lint on playbooks and roles.
